scope: Core adoption, verification, artifact/release and rollout coordination, shared Repo Standards consumption, and discovered parser/corpus state. Each listed model has one authoritative implementation; retained protocols and external ownership exceptions are recorded below.

tables.decision: No database drivers or executed DDL in maintained Python packages; no TypeScript SQLite imports; documentation Worker binds ASSETS only. SQL examples are analyzer fixtures, not application tables. No migration is required for this repository.

machines.eventsAndCommands: track, publish intent, atomic write, acknowledge, release
machines.guardsAndEffects: Intent precedes side effect; receipt follows effect; uncertain publication preserves Writing and prior receipt
machines.recovery: A crash between intent and receipt leaves Writing, not a fabricated non-action. SourceChanged restores only the known prior receipt; other interruptions preserve uncertainty for guarded rollback.

machines.old: repeated snapshot restoration without explicit per-path completion
machines.replacement: ACTIVE | RECOVERING | Complete; each acknowledged path becomes Released
machines.eventsAndCommands: begin recovery, decide restore, restore, acknowledge, retry
machines.guardsAndEffects: CAS on captured bytes/mode/group; retry only unresolved paths and never overwrite later human edits
machines.recovery: Persisted files are compared to captured and published bytes/mode/group. Released paths are never restored again. Partial recovery retries unresolved paths; completed recovery is an idempotent no-op.

machines.eventsAndCommands: apply scaffold, sync, install, interrupt, recover
machines.guardsAndEffects: Successful sync required for success; retain rollback and cleanup failure evidence; status130 remains interruption
machines.recovery: Interruption remains exit130. Rollback and cleanup failures remain attached to the specific failure result; cleanup cannot convert a failed sync/install into success.

machines.guardsAndEffects: Strict nonbool positive IDs and complete counts; exact workflow, repository, source and explicit job attempt
machines.recovery: Re-read the exact provider run/attempt before reuse. Download and extraction stay private until verification; missing, failed, skipped, changed or ambiguous proof selects fresh canonical verification.

justifiedRetentions.reason: Retain its dependency-free, explicitly bounded three-round mirror algorithm. Typed permanent-source errors retire a source; transient failures keep it eligible. Only a checksum-verified file is atomically renamed. No persisted retry journal or competing application source of truth exists.

AnalysisReport, ToolReport and RuleExecution already have closed enums, frozen values and centralized runtime cross-field invariants. Quantities and external tool coverage are runtime evidence; incomplete execution must retain issues and cannot qualify as success. The V1 output schema and normalized cache readers remain authoritative.

The existing frozen Status result already validates its enum and status/exit-code agreement centrally. Findings and changes are valid shared data for all six outcomes; no lifecycle writer mutates this result.

Use the owned Popen handle, reader-thread completion and cancellation Event as the authoritative external synchronization ports instead of duplicating OS states. Keep the session leader unreaped until inherited pipes close, refuse signaling after reap, and reap/close on failed thread startup or interruption. POSIX ownership is tested with waitid(WNOWAIT) before the real group signal.

Display raw GitHub job observations without interpreting missing or unknown provider data as successful qualification. Exact source/run/attempt proofs in the qualification paths authorize reuse and publication.

Retain the Typer parsing buffer at its input boundary. Execution-specific rollout data is converted to closed requests. CheckScope request scope and resolved PR scope are independent and can both be true; React Doctor triggering and staged Git environment are independent facts, not mutually exclusive lifecycle states.

Keep independently validated language destinations, exclusions, baseline policies and analyzer configuration. A default root or missing optional provider fact is not a disabled/completed job. Manifest parsing and source preconditions remain required.

Retain bounded AST/schema/graph walks and normalized source-coordinate records, including parser-owned partial observations. They do not own application jobs, approvals or external business effects. The shared public analyzers have consumers outside the named applications; absence from one application is not evidence that a published rule is unused.

sharedDependency: Repo Standards 7.0.0 replaces the former nullable analysis selection/commit-result consumer assumptions; the dependency owns repository policy rather than a second Core state model.
